input: How do I request a new laptop?
expected_output: Submit a ticket through the IT service desk portal under 'Hardware Requests'. Manager approval is required.
context: Employee hardware lifecycle: Laptops are refreshed every 3 years. For out-of-cycle replacements or new hires, submit a ticket via the IT service desk portal (Hardware Requests). All hardware requests require direct manager approval before fulfillment.

input: How do I reset my corporate password?
expected_output: Go to the internal identity portal at id.enterprise.internal and select 'Reset Password'.
context: Credential Management: Employees can self-serve password resets by navigating to the internal identity portal at id.enterprise.internal and choosing 'Reset Password'. Helpdesk intervention is only required if MFA tokens are locked out.

input: What is the policy for remote work stipends?
expected_output: Full-time employees receive a $500 annual remote work stipend submitted via the expense portal under 'Office Supplies'.
context: Remote Work Policy: Full-time employees are eligible for a $500 annual remote work stipend. Purchases must be submitted through the internal expense portal under the 'Office Supplies' category with an attached receipt.
